_comment: Canonical labels for every ontology id this atlas uses, vendored so tools/ontology.test.mjs can check offline. FMA ids resolve on EBI OLS4 and were cross-checked against Wikidata P1402. TAH ids are IFAA Terminologia Anatomica Humana unit pages (ifaa.unifr.ch/.../TAH<n>%20Unit%20EN.htm) and are used ONLY where the FMA has no term at all — every vein here. TAH cross-references FMA where both exist (TAH:U3863 carries FMA:49695), so the two namespaces agree rather than compete.
